description: This file is a Jupyter Notebook source file containing code for evaluating multiple LLM providers using the LiteLLM library. It includes code cells for installing dependencies, importing functions, setting environment variables, and performing various types of testing such as quality, load, and duration testing of language models. Additionally, it has cells demonstrating visualization of test results and explanations of different testing endpoints.
